FM 22 G. NO. 2
G. 90M-1-40

CRIME DIARY NO. 1. (SHEET NO. 2)

(j) What staff employed on premises?
(k) Are they all "old" servants?
(l) If not, what was their last employment
and for how long?
(m) What was their "characters"?
(n) If any suspicion attached to any of
them and if so, which one and for what
reason?
(o) Are old servants suspected?
(p) Are friends and visitors above suspicion
if not, who is suspected?

Do not apply.

Remarks
(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be
commented on by investigating officer).

At 10-15am. on 9/1/40 C.D.C. 230 attached to
the Special Branch came to Sinza Station with
S.S.D. Court Summonses No. 6206 and 6207 for the
two accused as described on Sheet 1, they being
the publisher-editor and printer respectively of
the "Shanghai News".

The two accused are charged with having
published an indecent article in this newspaper on
December 20th and 21st, a translation being:

"Prior to coition, the genital organs of the two
sexes are frequently developed into the state
suitable for coaption. In order to be able to be
inserted into the orifice, the male organ must be
erect, whereas the external part of the vagina must
also be to some extent responsive to enable to
insertion of the male organ.
At the time of coition, the vestibule of the vagina
is expanded with blood and the laborium presents a
visible swelling, particularly the clitoris, which
is the most sensitive part of the female organ and
through which friction is raised. In the meantime
the various glands in the genital organ emit sticky
fluid moistening every part of the vestibule.
The friction between the two organs enhances the
physical enjoyment of the two parties and discharge
follows, which is not limited to the male sex. In
the course of the ejaculation of the semen, the
vestibule of the vagina contracts, and the discharge
of semen marks the climax of the sexual intercourse.
According to latest research, the female sex is not
actually placed in the passive position and in fact
she also plays an active part. At this juncture the
entire portion of her genital organ undergoes a
systematic contraction, the womb descends and opens
in order to take in the semen. After the semen
discharge, it enters the stage of retirement. The
sensation of relaxation gives comfort to the whole
body."

Assistance was given by C.D.C. 99, and the
summonses were served. The hearing is on 18/1/40.

（左侧手写批注：10/1 G/c）
（签名：Sen. Det.）
D.D.O. "B"
（右侧签名：Dr. Wilson. D.S.I.）

FM 22 G. 编号 2
G. 90M-1-40

犯罪日志第1号（第2页）

(j) 处所内雇用了哪些职员？
(k) 他们是否均为“老”仆役？
(l) 若非如此，他们此前的受雇情况如何，历时多久？
(m) 他们的“品行”如何？
(n) 是否有任何人受到怀疑？如有，是哪一位，原因何在？
(o) 老仆役是否受到怀疑？
(p) 朋友和访客是否无可疑之处？若否，谁受到怀疑？

不适用。

备注
（由调查警官对任何突出或特殊情况进行评注）。

1940年1月9日上午10时15分，附属于特务科的华籍侦探警长（C.D.C.）230号携两张针对 sheet 1 所述两名被告的特别搜查科（S.S.D.）法院传票（编号6206和6207）抵达新闸捕房，该二人分别为《上海新闻》（Shanghai News）的发行人兼编辑及印刷人。

两名被告被控于12月20日和21日在该报刊登淫秽文章，译文如下：

“在性交之前，两性的生殖器官经常发育至适合交合的状态。为了能够插入孔口，男性器官必须勃起，而阴道外部也必须在一定程度上产生反应，以便男性器官插入。
在性交时，阴道前庭充血扩张，阴唇呈现明显的肿胀，尤其是阴蒂，这是女性器官最敏感的部分，摩擦由此产生。同时，生殖器官中的各种腺体分泌粘性液体，湿润前庭的各个部分。
两个器官之间的摩擦增强了双方的肉体快感，随后发生泄出，这不仅限于男性。在精液射精过程中，阴道前庭收缩，精液的排出标志着性 intercourse 的高潮。根据最新研究，女性实际上并非处于被动地位，事实上她也发挥积极作用。在此时刻，她生殖器官的整个部分 undergoes 系统性收缩，子宫下降并张开以接纳精液。精液排出后，进入消退阶段。放松的感觉使全身舒适。”

华籍侦探警长（C.D.C.）99号提供了协助，传票已送达。听证日期为1940年1月18日。

（左侧手写批注：1/10 G/c）
（签名：高级探员）
副警务总监 “B”
（右侧签名：威尔逊博士. 助理警务总监）
